timeline: If you stand before Mahabalipuram's ancient Shore Temple today, six missing sister temples may lie directly beneath the waves.
After the wave retreated, ancient ruins appeared.
In seven hundred twenty-five AD, King Rajasimha carved granite.
Massive waves struck the Tamil Nadu coast.
Hard granite bedrock saved the main tower.
Surging tides uncovered long-lost Pallava sculptures.
European sailors spoke of seven ancient pagodas.
Six sister temples are believed to remain buried beneath the waves.
Yet one ancient sanctuary remains watching.
